steps.title: Ask $possible for a robot snake
steps.instructions: Invoke the $possible skill with the idea. It asks a few questions before preparing the build.
steps.prompt:
$possible

I want to make a robot snake.

steps.title: Say what it should do
steps.prompt: I want it to slither convincingly and navigate around obstacles on its own.

steps.title: Describe the environment
steps.prompt:
A smooth indoor floor.

Continue from my previous answer.

steps.title: Say where you are starting from
steps.instructions: Say where you are starting from
steps.prompt: I am starting from scratch. I only have the idea.

steps.title: Choose the result you want
steps.instructions: Answer its last question and accept the pack it proposes. The agent then builds the CAD, robot description, simulation and tests.
steps.prompt:
A convincing digital prototype I can inspect and simulate now, with a clear path toward fabricating it later.

Yes, proceed with this pack.

preview.description: A ten-link robot snake that slithers in a MuJoCo simulation and steers around an obstacle on its own, with an inspectable 3D model.

video.caption: MuJoCo simulation, 190 simulated seconds shown in 18: lateral undulation, a range-triggered detour around a cylinder, and rejoining the route with no contact. Propulsion uses a simulated surrogate.
